mock.heading: How we choose our wool
mock.meta: By the Northwind Goods team — March 2024
mock.lead: Every throw starts as a conversation with a mill, not a spreadsheet. Here's what we actually look for.

content.text: We work with three small mills, each chosen for the same reason: they can tell us exactly which farm a fleece came from.
isn't a marketing word for us — it's the difference between a throw you keep for a decade and one you don't.
Fibre length and crimp, checked by hand
A mill that pays shearers a fair, published rate
Undyed lots we can dye small-batch ourselves
If we can't tell you which valley it came from, we don't buy it.
That standard costs more up front. It also means a Northwind throw looks the same in year five as it did on day one.

blocks.name: Breadcrumbs
blocks.description: Trail from Home to the current page. The design spec builds this from the page tree, but a block cannot read the route (no Nuxt globals, and `useEldraPage()` is page-level) — `trail` is the theme's stand-in: fill it per page from the parent levels above this one.

fields.name: Trail
fields.description: The levels between Home and this page, root first. Not editable from the page tree — fill it by hand per page.

fields.name: Current page title

fields.name: Show current page
fields.description: Off ends the trail at the parent.

fields.name: Container

fields.name: Variant
fields.helpText: default: brand, inline links and actions. centered: brand centred with links on a second row. minimal: brand, search, cart and a Menu button at every width.

fields.helpText: Shown as the wordmark when no logo is set. Keep it under 20 characters — it never wraps.

fields.helpText: SVG or PNG. Replaces the wordmark. Shown 2rem tall, max 10rem wide.

fields.name: Links
fields.helpText: Primary links. 3 to 6 recommended; more than 6 may overflow at 64–80rem.

fields.name: Label
fields.helpText: Two words max. Stays on one line.

fields.name: Mega-menu links
fields.helpText: Filling this turns the item into a mega-menu disclosure. Consecutive items that share the same Group form one column, in order — up to 4 groups × 8 links.

fields.name: Group
fields.helpText: Column heading. Consecutive links sharing the same group form one column.

fields.name: Feature cards
fields.helpText: Up to 2 image cards on the right of the mega-menu.

fields.name: Show search
fields.helpText: Opens Search (also on / and ⌘K / Ctrl+K).

fields.name: Search style
fields.helpText: icon: a ghost icon button. field: a pill field-like trigger, from 64rem only. inline: a live search bar in the bar, centered variant only, from 64rem only.

fields.name: Show account
fields.helpText: Shown in the bar from 64rem, and always in the drawer.
